scope: Both cases, both noise settings, every declared weight/objective configuration and five paired seeds; no best-weight, seed or checkpoint filtering.

stages.prefix: Require all 680 fixed-budget epoch-150 evaluations, including authoritative checkpoint-150 metadata while a continuation is running.
stages.full: Require all 680 tasks at their declared maximum budget and all 880 task/evaluation-epoch pairs.

uncertainty: Arithmetic means and sample standard deviations across the five data/initialization seeds. Paired contrasts use seed-matched differences and a two-sided Student-t 95% interval with four degrees of freedom. These are descriptive small-sample intervals, without a multiple-comparison significance claim.
oat: Display all six components, factors 0/0.1/1/10 and every predeclared dense strong/anchor factor; the shared default is included at factor one. Errors and downstream BIR retain both cases and noise settings.
budget: Display all five predeclared longer variants at 150, 500 and 1500 epochs; compare changes within each seed, never select the lowest-error epoch.
interactions: Display the complete strong-by-anchor 3x3 grid at factors 0.1/1/10 and the four corner second differences y(a,b)-y(a,1)-y(1,b)+y(1,1). These describe the measured responses, not the full six-dimensional interaction surface.
gradient: Retain raw and weighted component losses, all/D/R parameter-block norms, cosines and actual-update dot products. Report per-seed normalized magnitude shares before aggregation. A post-update gradient dotted with the previous actual Adam update is a local directional diagnostic, not an exact finite loss change or causal attribution.
numerics: The actual float32 diagnostics retain direct-versus-component discrepancies and legacy heuristic flags. Independent promoted-input/state FP64 gates must all pass. Undefined zero-norm cosines remain missing, never zero.
references: Shared non-oracle same-objective seven-coefficient polynomial controls are joined with unconstrained and positive-diffusion arms separate, their different hypothesis class stated, and input/per-variant weights matched. Oracle rows cannot enter these comparison plots. Separately, read the existing 60 strong/space-weak/space-time direct D2/R3 residual-fit coefficients from forward-v2 and evaluate the common 256-point closure errors. These are the same 60 fits reused by both reports, not additional independent samples or newly fitted references, and their objectives differ from the neural hybrid objective.
partial_policy: Incomplete reporting requires an explicit --allow-partial flag, records every missing/failing task and evaluation, and watermarks every figure. Complete reporting is the default.
